title: Skipping Stones — spores scattered lateral and medial
concept: Each spore hits the surface like a flat stone on a lake. It bounces. Each bounce creates concentric ripples. Multiple stones' ripples INTERFERE. The interference pattern IS the signal. You don't aim the stone — you just throw it flat and let physics decide the skips.

skip_pattern.description: Lateral = sideways across platforms and audiences. Medial = inward toward the center, strengthening the core. Like stone skipping: the first skip is biggest (closest to throw), each subsequent skip is smaller but goes further.

interference_patterns.description: When two stones' ripples meet, they INTERFERE. Constructive interference = amplification. Destructive = cancellation. The pattern is where the signal lives.
